notes.title: Health Pack Bug Patch
notes.content: Small patch to fix health pack functionality. Health packs can now be refilled at spawners.

notes.title: Albatross v1.0.0-454 Patch Notes:
notes.content:
[b]Qureo Online Services[/b]
Login Failure Screen fixed

[b]Map Updates[/b]
New Map! City is a New Elimination Map!

[b]Item Updates[/b]
New Item! The Health Pack (only available in Elimination currently) will allow you to heal anywhere ONCE and this at the cost of one item slot until your next death!

notes.title: Status Update!
notes.content: I decided to switch my focus to the Lyra template from Epic Games for now. I will be pursuing this template to keep the FPS Multiplayer Template pristine. I may go back to the FPS template and make it my own! I hope you see what can come in the future!

notes.title: WOW!
notes.content:
WOW, 27,000 visits in a week! So we are aware that there are no servers, this is because it is player hosted. When we made this originally it was for groups of friends to be able to mess around and have other people join in on the action. I am aware of multiple bugs and errors. I will be fixing them soon! Stay tuned! 

VICTORY IS IN YOUR HANDS!

- Qureo Development Team
